text_block_list.text:
The "journey" with Dream Journey.
Those three years have finally come to an end.

And...
a little time passed—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Orfevre breaks away!!
Passing the 200-meter mark with a lead of a length and a half!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Haaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A crushing victory for Orfevre!!!
She crosses the line!!"
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: Holy crap...!! A total blowout win...!!! What an unbelievable Umamusume that just showed up...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, she's Dream Journey's little sister, isn't she?
Both sisters are totally insane!!
I'm already getting starry-eyed over this...!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: She is a sister to be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —History is once again on the move.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And that... with my little sister at the center of it all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And once again... the connection carries on.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Turning to gold, lasting long—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ………………Now, here is a question.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: What do you think I'm going to do now?
...Such a fragrance—

Dream Journey's familiar resolve...
tickles my instincts as her Trainer.
choice_data_list: Let me take you to a dream once more.

text_block_list.text:
The people.
The running Umamusume.
The racing world.
And—
Myself, and her.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...That's the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That's just like you.
...Trainer.
